relevance_note: This exome study of juvenile-onset SLE describes one identifiable patient with a PSTPIP1 variant: 'A recurrent variant in PSTPIP1 (c.748G>A p.(Glu250Lys)) led to the identification of an autoinflammatory disorder known as PAMI syndrome in Pt14'.
method_note: Read the full paper including the converted supplementary files (mmc1 gene list excerpt, mmc2 Tables 1-3). Only Pt14 carries a PSTPIP1 variant; the other 16 diagnosed probands (other genes) and the rest of the 172-proband cohort are out of scope and get no rows. The 'one patient with SLE^48' previously described with PAMI syndrome is mentioned in passing with no individual-level fact beyond the diagnosis, so no row. cohort_size_as_stated = 172 probands (the paper also states 263 sequenced individuals including 202 patients with lupus). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is true for the paper as a whole (patients 2, 4 and 9-12); Pt14 is not among them and is one of the 'novel, unreported patients'. n_patients_reported = 1 is my count of PSTPIP1 carriers described (the paper gives no explicit number). Age 4 years is Table 1 'Age at lupus onset' (Supplementary Table 1 'Age at disease onset' also 4); recorded as age at onset; it may not be onset of the autoinflammatory features. Zygosity 'heterozygous' comes from the Table 1 legend 'Unless specified, variants are heterozygous.' applied to Pt14's unspecified row. Inheritance not reported: transmission 'Unknown', solo exome. Supplementary Table 1 (mmc2 sheet 'Probands clinical data') Yes/No organ-involvement columns were read for Pt14 (row Y798): Mucocutaneous Yes, Renal No, Hematological Yes, Joint Yes, Neurological No; 'No' read as explicit absence; header quoted as second span. Renal involvement 'No' was taken to exclude the checklist item kidney involvement. 'Articular involvement'/'Joint involvement: Yes' was NOT mapped to the arthritis checklist item because arthritis is not stated (could be arthralgia); left not reported. Rosacea-like lesions not mapped to acne. 'negative anti ds-DNA' recorded under D-27 as 'positive anti-dsDNA antibodies' excluded. Minor discrepancy: type I IFN signature 4.4 in Table 1 vs 4.3 in Supplementary Table 1. No contradictions about presence/absence of features. Spans were assembled by a small Python script from the paper lines and each checked verbatim against the paper.
